title: JobRequirements
description: A job's CONFIRMED skill requirements: written by the assessment module after a person confirmed them, read by M6 to shortlist candidates. Must-haves are filters, each with its own bar; nice-to-haves are shown, never combined into a ranking.

skill_list_version.description: schemas/skills/ontology.yaml version the ids are from.

bar.description: A FILTER: a candidate qualifies when this skill's interval clears the bar — its lower bound, by default. null: required, but to be ASSESSED rather than filtered on — nobody has evidence for a skill before they are tested on it.

assessable.description: The assessment module has a pattern for this skill.

not_on_list.description: Skills the job description names that the shared skill list does not hold. Reported so nobody assumes they were checked.
